content.short: Isolated, risk-adjusted money markets for lending and borrowing on Sonic and Plasma.
content.description: Enclabs splits its lending markets into isolated pools, so trouble with one asset cannot spread to the others. Alongside a core market it runs pools for liquid-staked tokens and Spectra principal tokens, letting users borrow against fixed-yield positions. Users earn supply interest and rewards, and the protocol is tied into the veTrevee ecosystem.
content.meta: Lend and borrow in isolated, risk-adjusted Enclabs pools on Sonic and Plasma, including markets for Spectra PT tokens.
